body.zh-Hant: 美國國會圖書館的人名權威檔記基謝伊瓦諾夫（Georgi Kyoseivanov）生於1884年、卒於1960年。德國國家圖書館的人名權威檔記他出生於佩什特拉（Peschtera）、卒於瑞士，並註記其身分為首相（Ministerpräsident）。
body.en: The Library of Congress name authority gives Georgi Kyoseivanov's dates as 1884–1960. The German National Library authority record gives Peshtera (Peschtera) as his place of birth and Switzerland as his place of death, and notes him as prime minister (Ministerpräsident).

people.name: Manuel de Jesús Troncoso de la Concha
people.nameZh: 曼努埃爾·德赫蘇斯·特龍科索·德拉孔查

body.zh-Hant: 曼努埃爾·德赫蘇斯·特龍科索·德拉孔查1878年4月3日生於聖多明各，父親是赫蘇斯·馬里亞·特龍科索（1855–1924）。1895年11月26日他取得學士（Bachiller）學位，並在授位典禮上代表致謝；其後修習法律，1899年4月14日取得法學學位，當時剛滿21歲。
body.en: Manuel de Jesús Troncoso de la Concha was born in Santo Domingo on 3 April 1878, the son of Jesús María Troncoso (1855–1924). On 26 November 1895 he received the degree of Bachiller and gave the speech of thanks at the ceremony; he then studied law and obtained his licenciatura on 14 April 1899, just after turning twenty-one.

body.zh-Hant: 1899年11月他受任為聖多明各司法區的預審法官，其後擔任第一審法院院長、共和國檢察總長、土地高等法院院長與司法部長（國務卿）。1914年他進入聖多明各大學任教，講授民法；1916年擔任制憲國民議會成員，並在1917年主持索賠委員會。
body.en: In November 1899 he was appointed examining judge of the Santo Domingo judicial district and later served as president of the Court of First Instance, Attorney General of the Republic, president of the Superior Land Court and Secretary of State for Justice. In 1914 he joined the faculty of the University of Santo Domingo, where he taught civil law; in 1916 he was a member of the Constituent National Assembly, and in 1917 he presided over the Claims Commission.

body.zh-Hant: 1938年他當選共和國副總統（任期1938–1940）。1940年總統哈辛托·佩納多去世後，他於3月7日接任總統，任職至1942年5月18日，之後把權力交給「人民選出」的特魯希略大元帥（Generalísimo）。
body.en: In 1938 he was elected Vice-President of the Republic (1938–1940). When President Jacinto B. Peynado died in 1940 he took over the presidency on 7 March, holding it until 18 May 1942, when he handed power to Generalísimo Trujillo, described as the people's elected choice.

heading.zh-Hant: 參議院議長與學術職務

body.zh-Hant: 卸任總統後，他出任參議院議長直至去世（歷史學院簡歷寫自1943年起，Clio 訃傳寫自1942年起）。1944年9月他當選多明尼加歷史學院院長，並連任至1955年5月30日去世；他也是多明尼加語言學院的創始成員。作品包括《聖多明各被海地佔領》（1942）。喪禮上遺體移靈參議院宮。
body.en: After leaving the presidency he presided over the Senate until his death (the Academy profile says from 1943, the Clio obituary from 1942). In September 1944 he was elected president of the Academia Dominicana de la Historia, serving by re-election until his death on 30 May 1955; he was also a founding member of the Academia Dominicana de la Lengua. His works include La ocupación de Santo Domingo por Haití (1942). At his funeral the body was taken to the Senate palace.

body.zh-Hant: 腓特烈八世（Christian Frederik Vilhelm Carl）1843年6月3日生於哥本哈根的黃色宮殿，父母是後來的克里斯蒂安九世與黑森-卡塞爾的路易絲。1860年堅信禮後，他受任為步兵少尉，並在尼堡的步兵營與奈斯特韋德的龍騎兵團繼續軍事訓練；1864年戰爭期間，他隨隊在日德蘭，隸屬哈格曼-林德克龍將軍的幕僚。
body.en: Frederik VIII (Christian Frederik Vilhelm Carl) was born on 3 June 1843 in the Yellow Palace in Copenhagen, the son of the future Christian IX and Louise of Hesse-Kassel. After his confirmation in 1860 he was appointed second lieutenant in the infantry and continued his military training with the 19th infantry battalion at Nyborg and the 4th dragoon regiment at Næstved; during the 1864 war he was attached to General Hegermann-Lindencrone's staff in Jutland.

citations.quote: Frederik 8., Christian Frederik Vilhelm Carl, 3.6.1843-14.5.1912, konge.
Frederik blev født i Det gule palæ, Kbh. (Slotsk.)
Forældre: senere Christian 9. (1818-1906) og Louise af Hessen-Kassel
Efter sin konfirmation 1860 udnævntes han til sekondløjtnant i infanteriet
fortsatte sin militære uddannelse ved 19. infanteribataljon i Nyborg
og ved 4. dragonregiment i Næstved
Under krigen 1864 var han attacheret general Cai Hegermann-Lindencrones
Hegermann-Lindencrones stab i Jylland

body.zh-Hant: 1863年11月15日父親即位，腓特烈以王儲身分進入國務會議，支持父親讓石勒蘇益格、荷爾斯泰因與勞恩堡與王國維持人合的主張；普魯士攻占阿爾斯後，他認為戰爭已敗，接受了嚴苛的預備和約與最終和約，並在1864年11月12日的國務會議上對和約發言。1869年7月28日他與瑞典-挪威的路易絲在斯德哥爾摩成婚，1891年出任陸軍總監。Lex稱他當了43年王儲，幾乎被排除於影響力之外；他是議會的熱心旁聽者，並在1894年運用有限的影響力推動政治和解。
body.en: When his father acceded on 15 November 1863, Frederik became a member of the Council of State as crown prince and backed his father's attempt to keep Schleswig, Holstein and Lauenburg in personal union with the kingdom; after the Prussian conquest of Als he considered the war lost accepted the harsh preliminaries and the final peace, about which he spoke in the Council of State on 12 November 1864. On 28 July 1869 he married Louise of Sweden-Norway in Stockholm, and in 1891 he became army inspector. Lex says he was crown prince for 43 years, almost wholly cut off from influence; he was a diligent listener in the Rigsdag and in 1894 used his modest influence to promote the political compromise.

støttede her faderens forsøg på at bevare Slesvig, Holsten og Lauenborg

Han accepterede de hårde fredspræliminarer og den endelige fred
om hvilken han i statsrådet 12.11.1864 sagde at
Gift 28.7.1869 i Stockholm med Louise af Sverige-Norge
og blev 1891 hærinspektør
Som kronprins gennem 43 år var Frederik næsten helt afskåret fra indflydelse
Han var en flittig tilhører i rigsdagen
den ret ubetydelige indflydelse han havde til at fremme det politiske forlig
forlig 1894

body.zh-Hant: 1906年1月29日父親去世，腓特烈即位為國王，並願意作為立憲君主。他關心冰島的地位：1907年他與議員和工商代表訪問冰島，設立由冰島議會與國會代表組成的委員會；該委員會1908年提出報告，主張冰島成為與丹麥結成實質聯合的獨立國家，但方案在冰島遭否決，令國王大感失望。
body.en: On the death of his father on 29 January 1906 Frederik became king, ready to be a constitutional monarch. He cared about Iceland's position: in 1907 he visited Iceland with Rigsdag members and business representatives and set up a commission of Althing and Rigsdag representatives; its 1908 report proposed that Iceland become an independent country in real union with Denmark, but the proposal was rejected in Iceland, to the king's great disappointment.

kom han med redebon vilje til at være konstitutionel monark

body.zh-Hant: 1908年7至8月，腓特烈與王后路易絲巡遊日德蘭，由首相J.C.克里斯滕森陪同；約一個月後，前司法大臣阿爾貝蒂向警方自首並承認偽造與詐欺，內閣隨之請辭。1909年8月16日他委託霍爾斯泰因-累德堡組閣，同年10月該內閣遭人民院通過激進派不信任議程而辭職；激進派的察勒內閣任期很短，1910年選舉後克勞斯·貝恩森出任首相。1912年春他心臟病發，5月14日在漢堡街頭猝逝。
body.en: In July–August 1908 Frederik and Queen Louise toured Jutland accompanied by the Council President J.C. Christensen; a month later the former justice minister P.A. Alberti gave himself up to the police and confessed to forgery and fraud, and the ministry resigned. On 16 August 1909 Frederik had Holstein-Ledreborg form a government, which resigned in October 1909 after the Folketing adopted a radical motion of no confidence; the Radical Zahle ministry sat only briefly, and after the 1910 election Klaus Berntsen became Council President. In spring 1912 he suffered a heart attack and on 14 May 1912 collapsed and died in the street in Hamburg.
